scripts.back: cross-env-shell "docker compose up -d && cd backend && uv run python -u manage.py runserver"
scripts.back:install: cross-env-shell "cd backend && uv venv --allow-existing && uv pip install -r requirements.txt"
scripts.back:migrate: cross-env-shell "cd backend && uv run python -u manage.py migrate"
scripts.install:all: cross-env-shell "pnpm install && pnpm front:install && pnpm back:install"
scripts.init:all: cross-env-shell "pnpm install:all && docker compose up -d &&pnpm back:migrate && pnpm dev"
